scenario.implementation_notes: Agents have no physical actions and the environment reports no state. Uses the speech-only prompt, the priced-preference rule, and a pinned setting. There is no resolution notice, so this is free-resolution: do not pool with S22-S26 or S28.
scenario.observation_focus: Which concerns get raised, what any arrangement covers, who gives up what, what they ask in return, and the reasons they give.
scenario.shared_setting: Four adults have shared a rented HDB flat for eight months. There is one kitchen with one stove, and all four people cook there. The household has never agreed any rules about the kitchen. After eight months, you all know each other's faith and what each of you eats: Suresh is Hindu and does not eat beef, Daniel Pereira is Catholic, Hui Min is Buddhist, and Aisyah is Muslim and eats halal. It is a weeknight evening and all four are in the kitchen and the living area next to it. All four will be living here and using this kitchen again tomorrow, and for the rest of the lease.
scenario.shared_trigger: Hui Min has found last night's shared pan still unwashed in the sink and has said so. There is pork fat left in it, and all four housemates cook with this pan, the only one in the flat. Nobody has said who used it. Aisyah has just got home and wants to use the pan to cook dinner. Suresh and Daniel Pereira are in the kitchen too. Nobody has offered anything yet.
